findings.message: Content Security Policy headers are not configured. This is a pre-existing gap unrelated to this feature.
findings.evidence: next.config.ts contains only reactCompiler: true — no headers() configuration.
findings.suggested_action: Track for a future hardening pass. When the application serves user-facing pages, add a headers() block in next.config.ts defining a strict Content-Security-Policy that restricts script-src, object-src, and base-uri. This must be done in a dedicated security hardening feature, not in this data-modelling feature.

findings.message: BehavioralContractWireSchema and its child schemas use .passthrough(), allowing unknown keys through the parsed object. This is intentional per REQ-010 and PRD §20.1.
findings.evidence: BehavioralContractWireSchema = z.object({...}).passthrough() at lines 80-87; BehavioralRuleWireSchema at line 64-78; BehavioralEvidenceWireSchema at lines 38-62.
findings.suggested_action: No action required for this feature. If the wire format is later stabilised and unknown keys should be rejected, replace .passthrough() with .strict() in BehavioralContractWireSchema, BehavioralRuleWireSchema, and BehavioralEvidenceWireSchema. This would be a deliberate breaking change to the wire protocol and must be coordinated with the analysis pipeline feature.
